key_provisions_or_claims: Welcomes the Data Governance Act and its data altruism organisations and cooperative data models.
Notes AI is a contested concept; the definition in the AI Act proposal will be addressed in a separate EESC opinion.
Calls for SME support and caution against hasty or strict regulation.
Calls for employee involvement in AI deployment and for a positive liability regime for online marketplaces under the DSA.
annotation.summary_en: European Economic and Social Committee exploratory opinion, requested by the Slovenian Council Presidency, on the opportunities of digitalisation for SMEs. It answers questions on the Data Governance Act, the AI Act's definition of AI and the Digital Services Act. It reaffirms human-in-command AI and urges SME support without hasty regulation.
